text: During a tuner preview (non-default smoother/α) the hero stat and delta chip currently swap to the preview values while the banner claims 'the saved trend keeps the default smoother' (WLO-0054 §B). Which behavior?
suggestions: Keep the hero following the tuner, but add a visible 'preview' mark + Reset path (recommended — live what-if feel, honestly labeled)
Freeze hero/delta at the canonical saved read during preview; only the chart line previews (strictest WLO-0030 defect-9 reading)
